reason: I'd take the free call and look at the 15 companies, because that costs me nothing. But paying EUR 1,600 to let an agency talk to buyers in my name? Not this month. My customers buy from me because they know me, and one logistics case with 45 meetings doesn't tell me anything about wholesale in my niche.
objection: For about the same money I could put a junior on Apollo and the phone for six weeks, and he'd stay with the company afterwards. I don't believe an outsider gets my buyers to sit down with me, and a meeting with someone who never orders is wasted time.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 has names I recognise as real buyers I haven't reached yet, and I can speak to a wholesaler like me who got real orders, not just meetings, I'd do the pilot in relationship mode before my next trade fair.
